name: git-into-gsoc
description: Evidence-based preparation for Google Summer of Code: find organizations, repositories and free beginner issues, get oriented in a codebase, and prepare a proposal, with an Agent Skill and an MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare for Google Summer of Code one step at a time

defaultPrompt: Help me get started with Google Summer of Code
Find GSoC organizations that use Python
